tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Ink: all text on ivory and white (15.3:1 on ivory, 18.7:1 on white), every border, every hard shadow, the hand-drawn rules. Also text on yellow (11.5:1). Never pure #000.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the carpet, figure-frame and dialog interiors, inactive tabs, chips. Also the light text colour on cobalt (4.7:1). On green (4.4:1) and red (4.2:1) it passes only for text 24px+ or bold 19px+: use white for smaller text there.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised paper: card bodies, secondary buttons, round controls, popovers, title bars, white boxes in diagrams. White text on red (5.1:1), green (5.4:1) or cobalt (5.8:1) is the safe choice for small text on a colour fill.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: First accent. Project 01 band, primary buttons, selected tabs, the Portfolio block, the 'request path' in diagrams, links in body copy (4.7:1 on ivory, 5.8:1 on white). Ivory or white text on it.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Second accent. Project 02 band, the LinkedIn block, Postgres in diagrams, COMPLETE status tags. Text on it: ivory only at 24px+ (4.4:1), white below that (5.4:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Third accent. The GitHub block, external services in diagrams, LOADING / not-yet tags. Text on it: ivory only at 24px+ (4.2:1), white below that (5.1:1). Not an error colour on its own: pair it with a word.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Highlighter. ACTIVE / In progress pills, the Next-up note, the Email block, diagram title tapes and the Cloudflare header. Always black text on it (11.5:1), never ivory or white.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed strokes only: arrows and dashed edges for future or build-time paths. 3.1:1 on ivory, so never body text.

tokens.name: dim-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text labels in diagrams (build, deploy, trigger). 5.8:1 on ivory, 7.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: green-top
tokens.usage: Top ellipse of the database cylinder in diagrams, one step lighter than green so the face reads as lit.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the zoom dialog: black at 72%.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One page title per page, uppercase. Responsive clamp(56px, 14vw, 112px). Fill white, 2px black text stroke (paint-order: stroke fill) and a 4px 4px 0 black drop-shadow filter.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title in a project card's colour band, uppercase. clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px).

styles.name: block-title
styles.usage: Name on a home-page link block, uppercase. clamp(26px, 4.5vw, 34px).

styles.name: role
styles.usage: The one-line role under the name on the home page, uppercase.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Champion pick recommendations from challenger match data
styles.usage: Sentence-case subtitle under a card title, same colour as the title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside cards, uppercase, with a 3px accent underline.

styles.name: caption-marker
styles.usage: Captions under trajectory nodes, uppercase, broken over short lines.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab labels and the touch zoom label, uppercase.

styles.name: scrawl
styles.usage: Two- or three-word lowercase asides only (link-block captions). Too thin for sentences.

styles.name: scrawl-label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels at the top of figure frames and diagram groups, at 65% opacity. 11px for the home trajectory label.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: One thing I built and one thing I proved.
styles.usage: Intro sentence under a page title, max 52ch. clamp(17px, 2.4vw, 20px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A pipeline that ingests every current-patch game.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Each player resumes from a checkpoint.
styles.usage: Bullet lists and the Next-up note. Lead-ins in weight 800.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Context line in a card band, popover text (weight 400).

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Status pills, uppercase. The home trajectory uses a 7.5px weight-700 version with 0.07em tracking.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and between items in a title bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Tagline and meta line above them; gap between round controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row and between list items.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between story paragraphs; figure-frame padding; top-right controls inset.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap in the home link-block grid; title-bar to page top.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding around the 960px column, and link-block side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Inner side padding of cards and card bands.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Column gap and top padding inside a card body.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between project cards; hero top padding on home.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: cards, buttons, tabs, chips, frames, dialogs. Corners are square by default.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round controls (replay, info, expand, close) and trajectory nodes.

shadow.note: Every shadow is a hard offset in black with no blur. Hover lifts an element 2px up-left (link blocks 3px) and grows its shadow by the same amount; press does the reverse.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Selected tab, status pills, the title-bar expand button.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Round controls, back link, boxes in diagrams, chips that need lift.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Buttons, the Next-up note, trajectory nodes.

tokens.name: shadow-5
tokens.usage: Figure frames, tab windows, popovers. Also round-control hover.

tokens.name: shadow-6
tokens.usage: Button hover; diagram group boxes.

tokens.name: shadow-7
tokens.usage: Home link blocks at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-8
tokens.usage: The zoom dialog.

tokens.name: shadow-9
tokens.usage: Project cards, the largest object on a page.

tokens.name: shadow-11
tokens.usage: Home link block hover.

border.note: Borders are solid black. Weight says how big the object is.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, frames, dialogs, round controls, card band and foot dividers.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Tabs, chips, status pills, diagram boxes, the touch zoom label.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: The 7.5px trajectory status tags only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Height of the hand-drawn horizontal rules between page sections.

tilt.note: Small rotations make blocks look placed by hand. Hover straightens them; reduced motion removes them.

tokens.name: tilt-card
tokens.usage: First project card. Alternate cards use 0.5deg.

tokens.name: tilt-card-alt
tokens.usage: Second project card.

tokens.name: tilt-block-1
tokens.usage: Home link block 1 (cobalt).

tokens.name: tilt-block-2
tokens.usage: Home link block 2 (green).

tokens.name: tilt-block-3
tokens.usage: Home link block 3 (red).

tokens.name: tilt-block-4
tokens.usage: Home link block 4 (yellow).

tokens.name: tilt-note
tokens.usage: The yellow Next-up note.

tokens.name: tilt-tape
tokens.usage: Yellow title tapes in diagrams.

tokens.name: tilt-rule
tokens.usage: Footer rule. Section rules use 0.35deg and -0.3deg.

tokens.name: opacity-carpet
tokens.usage: Final opacity of each Sierpinski carpet layer on the page ground.

tokens.name: opacity-off
tokens.usage: Future or disabled items (the Machine Learning Engineer node).

tokens.name: opacity-label
tokens.usage: Scrawl labels on frames and diagram groups.

tokens.name: opacity-num
tokens.usage: Index numbers (01, 02) on cards and link blocks.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column, centred, with gutter padding.

tokens.name: panel-aspect
tokens.usage: Aspect ratio of tab-window panels and diagrams (landscape letter; diagrams are drawn at 1100 x 850).

tokens.name: lede-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the lede under a page title.
